risks.title: Critical dependence on major technology partners
risks.summary: AudioCodes has made significant investments in compatibility with Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Cisco Webex and Genesys solutions. If these partners discontinue their offerings, promote competing products or refuse to recognize AudioCodes as a certified partner, operational results would be materially affected. The risk of a partner acquiring a competitor is explicitly mentioned.
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed at the beginning of the detailed section (Item 3.D), strong language ("will be harmed", "adversely affected"), stable but structural trend. AudioCodes depends on Microsoft Teams/Skype, Zoom, Cisco Webex, Genesys for product compatibility; partner abandonment or promotion of competitors would directly threaten revenues.

risks.title: Geopolitical instability in Israel and direct operational impact
risks.summary: AudioCodes' headquarters, approximately 50% of its employees and most of its senior management are based in Israel. Wars since October 2023 (Hamas, Hezbollah, Iran) have caused military reserve call-ups, indirect facility damage, reduced air traffic and increased insurance and transportation costs. Escalation in February 2026 with a joint US-Israel campaign against Iran. Risks include mass mobilization, movement restrictions, airport disruptions and heightened cybersecurity.
risks.score_rationale: Major risk detailed over 3 pages (Item 3.D), urgent language ("material adverse effect", "highly fluid"), trend UP since October 2023 with escalation in February 2026. 50% of employees and headquarters in Israel; wars with Hamas, Hezbollah, Iran create risks of mobilization, infrastructure damage, supply chain disruptions.

risks.title: Technological transition to cloud and SaaS threatens on-premises model
risks.summary: AudioCodes' partners (Microsoft, Cisco, etc.) are gradually adopting cloud/SaaS models. Microsoft Teams is cloud-only (successor to on-premises Skype for Business). AudioCodes risks failing to adapt its on-premises products in time or sufficiently. Pay-per-use SaaS licensing models affect short-term revenue recognition and reduce the value delivered to customers.
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed in business section (Item 3.D), moderate but clear language ("challenges", "may not succeed"), trend UP with increasing cloud adoption by partners. Current revenues primarily on-premises; SaaS transition affects revenue recognition and product architecture.

risks.title: Product obsolescence and next-generation transition management
risks.summary: The communications equipment market is characterized by rapid technological innovation. AudioCodes must quickly develop the next generation of products ahead of competitors to remain competitive. Risk of inventory write-offs due to obsolete products during transitions. New product development is costly, complex and time-consuming.
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed in business section (Item 3.D), strong language ("can become outmoded", "operating results may be harmed"), stable but structural trend in the sector. Communications equipment market characterized by rapid innovation; product development is costly and complex.

risks.title: Structural decline in demand for media gateway products
risks.summary: Media gateways transmit voice between traditional telephony networks and IP networks. With increasing adoption of IP networks, direct IP-to-IP communication reduces the need for media gateways. Regulators and service providers have announced timelines for transition to all-IP. This transition has already led to declining revenues in this product line.
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed in business section (Item 3.D), clear language ("may adversely affect", "decline in revenues"), trend DOWN with increasing direct IP adoption. Transition to all-IP networks reduces need for media gateways; trend confirmed by observed revenue decline.

risks.title: Dependence on global supply chain and component shortages
risks.summary: AudioCodes relies on third-party subcontractors for assembly, ODMs for design/manufacturing and suppliers for key components. This dependence exposes the company to geopolitical disruptions (conflicts, sanctions), shortages of critical components and rising costs. Inability to manufacture in sufficient quantities to meet market demand.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in summary and detailed (Item 3.D), strong language ("exposes us to disruptions", "may not be able to manufacture"), trend UP with geopolitical conflicts and critical shortages. AudioCodes depends on subcontractors, ODMs and third-party suppliers for key components.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks and reputational/regulatory damage
risks.summary: AudioCodes and its third-party vendors are exposed to cybersecurity risks and incidents. Consequences include brand damage, material financial penalties, legal liability and regulatory compliance issues. The geopolitical context in Israel (wars 2023-2026) increases regional cybersecurity threats.
risks.score_rationale: Risk listed in summary and detailed (Item 3.D), strong language ("damage to brand", "material financial penalties"), trend UP with increased threats in the Israeli geopolitical context. AudioCodes and third-party vendors exposed to cybersecurity incidents.

risks.title: R&D talent shortage in Israel and exponential salary costs
risks.summary: R&D-related salary expenses in Israel have increased exponentially due to a shortage of qualified talent and unfavorable exchange rates. Wars since 2023 and military mobilization intensify competition to recruit and retain qualified R&D employees, increasing operating costs.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in summary (Item 3.D), moderate language ("increased exponentially", "heightened competition"), trend UP since 2023 with wars and mobilization. R&D salary costs in Israel rising; increased competition to recruit qualified talent.

ai_positioning.summary: AudioCodes positions itself as a leader in Voice AI, with a clear strategy focused on integrating conversational AI into its cloud solutions for enterprises and service providers. The Voice AI product portfolio (Voca CIC, Meeting Insights, Interaction Insights, VoiceAI Connect, Live Hub) and growing adoption of AI features in commercial deals reflect this strategic direction.
